data_evidence: 68/87 patients had observed DMR; event-time median among events was 14.8 months, but first DMR is interval-observed
literature_coverage: Response milestones, early molecular response, DMR/MR4.5, and TFR eligibility are established
identified_gap: Routine data often identify DMR only between visits, not at an exact response date
manuscript_use: Justifies interval-survival or joint longitudinal-survival modeling

data_evidence: Median visit gap was 6.0 months; 50.3% of gaps exceeded 6 months and 20.0% exceeded 12 months
literature_coverage: Guidelines and real-world studies discuss monitoring schedules and feasibility
identified_gap: Few studies model how irregular monitoring changes DMR-time estimation
manuscript_use: Frames irregular follow-up as a central analytic feature

data_evidence: 495 repeated molecular observations include log-MRD and derived DMR/CMR states
literature_coverage: Molecular monitoring thresholds are well established
identified_gap: Continuous log-MRD trajectories are often reduced to categorical milestones
manuscript_use: Supports modeling log-MRD as a longitudinal biomarker

data_evidence: Many deep-response observations reach the reporting floor around log-MRD -5
literature_coverage: Assay performance and deep response concepts are described
identified_gap: Floor or lower-limit behavior is often treated as exact measurement
manuscript_use: Motivates sensitivity analysis for assay-floor behavior

data_evidence: PH+ cytogenetic percentages are available at baseline and landmark times but are incomplete
literature_coverage: Cytogenetic abnormalities and Philadelphia chromosome status remain clinically important
identified_gap: Sparse serial cytogenetic data are rarely integrated with longitudinal molecular response
manuscript_use: Use PH+ variables as descriptive or secondary covariates

data_evidence: Complete core covariates are available for 62/87 patients (71.3%)
literature_coverage: Reviews describe clinically important baseline and treatment factors
identified_gap: Incomplete real-world covariates limit standard multivariable modeling
manuscript_use: Report complete-case analyses and sensitivity limitations

data_evidence: Public modeling files use coded patient IDs and isolate the private patient key
literature_coverage: Real-world CML monitoring studies show the value of routine data
identified_gap: Privacy-preserving reproducible model-ready CML datasets are uncommon
manuscript_use: Position the data-cleaning workflow as a reproducible contribution

data_evidence: The cohort is small but longitudinally rich: 87 patients and 495 observations
literature_coverage: Joint models exist for longitudinal biomarkers and event outcomes
identified_gap: Applied CML examples with irregular monitoring and interval-observed DMR are scarce
manuscript_use: Frames the modeling contribution as applied joint/interval methodology
